title: Amphibia
body:
Welcome to Ncode's Amphibia mod! The mod is currently in beta and i have many things planned.

This mod adds things from the Disney show Amphibia, the Calamity Box, Amphibia, Calamity Gems, and more to come.

HOW IT WORKS
![This is the gems you use to get the calamity gems](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c89d40d437f28d8ccdfa5e530cd1b0bce2a9c2a7.png)
The gems here, are charged using a Supercharger, then charged again into the Calamity Gems, which when in your inventory, will give you status effects.

![You could either keep your calamity gems for the buffs, or create the Calamity Box.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2161c0b34ce95a634712309df16eac7773c6a38.png)
The Calamity Box is created with the Calamity Gems, Ancient Tech (look for wandering traders.), and super Redstone.

As of now, once you enter Amphibia, you cannot leave, this will be updated in the future.
